title: ON CALIBRATION OF LLM-BASED GUARD MODELS FOR RELIABLE CONTENT MODERATION

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and plotting reliability diagrams on prompt and response classification benchmarks to measure the gap between predictive confidence and actual accuracy.

Assessing model predictions when user inputs or model responses are replaced with content-free tokens (such as a space) or a single out-of-context word (like 'unsafe') to reveal persistent algorithmic priors.
